newsitem.title: USA: Nextwave Telecom files for debt, equity offerings.
newsitem.headline: Nextwave Telecom files for debt, equity offerings.

text.p: NextWave Telecom Inc said Friday it had filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission for an offering of senior note units, consisting of senior notes due 2007 and warrants to buy shares of Series B common stock, and senior discount note units, consisting of senior discount notes due 2007 and warrants to buy shares of Series B common.
NextWave also filed for an offering of equity units. Each unit would consist of one share of Series B common and one contingent transfer right.
CIBC Wood Gundy Securities Corp is the lead underwriter of the debt offering, and Smith Barney Inc is co-lead manager.
Smith Barney is the lead underwriter of the equity unit offering, which would be Nextwave's initial public offering. Lehman Brothers is the co-lead manager, the company said in a statement.
NextWave, which filed to trade under the symbol "SURF" on the Nasdaq, is a personal communications service provider with the third largest wireless franchise in the U.S.
